points.text: Elon Musk unveiled Tesla’s next-generation Roadster and demonstrated it leaving the ground, a feature that could raise regulatory questions.
Katie Zacharia left the White House press secretary role five days after taking it, following President Trump’s public suggestion that she reconsider.
A shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, killed three children and a teacher; police said the 16-year-old suspect also died at the school.
Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank, injuring several people, including Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine.
Officials said an order to temporarily limit Ukraine’s use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite system came from inside the White House.
